FN-HGGJ433-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 47
Committee: Economic Development and Sponsor: Representative Jim Hill
Tourism
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/26/2025
House Bill 47 as introduced proposes a constitutional amendment which, if ratified, would
allow the Legislature to authorize, license, tax and provide for the operation of traditional raffles
and traditional bingo for noncommercial charitable fundraising purposes.
Additionally, this bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the
State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027.
